cards.claim: Zoobles! originated in South Korea, as evidenced by its production in Seoul by SamG Animation and its South Korean cultural elements.
cards.quote: The answer lies in the bustling streets of Seoul, South Korea, a country in East Asia that has quietly become a hub for innovative animation and entertainment. Our journey begins in the early 2000s, when South Korea's animation industry was still in its infancy. Despite facing stiff competition from neighboring Japan and China, a small group of visionary animators and producers in Seoul were determined to make a mark on the global stage. Among them was a talented team of artists and writers who would eventually come together to create Zoobles!. One of the key pieces of evidence supporting Zoobles!' South Korean origins is the show's production company, SamG Animation. Founded in 2005, SamG is a Seoul-based studio that has produced a range of successful animated series, including Zoobles!.
